questions.question: Describe the importance of different functional units of a computer / system with the help of a block diagram
questions.solution_html:
• Functional units of a computer include Input Unit, Output Unit, Memory Unit, ALU, and Control
  • Unit. Input unit accepts data; memory stores data and programs; ALU performs arithmetic and logic
  • operations; Control Unit manages all operations; Output unit displays results. Data flow: Input →
  • Memory → CPU → Output.
questions.final_answer: Memory → CPU → Output
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Discuss in detail about data transfer and data manipulation instructions.
questions.solution_html:
• Data transfer and manipulation instructions include MOV, LOAD, STORE, PUSH, POP for
  • transfer; ADD, SUB, AND, OR, SHIFT, ROTATE for manipulation. These operations move, modify, and
  • process data efficiently within CPU cycles (fetch, decode, execute).
questions.final_answer: process data efficiently within CPU cycles (fetch, decode, execute)

questions.question: Differentiate between arithematic operations and logic operations with / example.
questions.solution_html:
• Arithmetic operations like ADD, SUB, MUL, DIV perform calculations, while logic operations like
  • AND, OR, XOR, NOT work on bits. Arithmetic affects numerical results; logic changes bit patterns.
  • Example: ADD R1, R2 vs AND R1, R2.
